  "ledger": [
    "00:00.000–00:03.500: Slender silver two-pronged tool stays in the right hand (screen left); its tips repeatedly contact the small metal mechanism held in the left hand (screen right, watch wrist).",
    "00:00.000–00:04.500: Small rounded metal mechanism remains between the left thumb and fingers, with ordinary partial finger occlusion; it is not released or placed on a surface.",
    "00:03.750–00:04.250: Right hand withdraws the silver tool and lowers it out through the bottom-left edge. A pale speck is visible near its tip during withdrawal, but cannot confidently be distinguished as a separate component. Neither tool nor speck visibly returns.",
    "00:04.500–00:05.500: Right hand returns without the long tool and joins the left hand around the metal mechanism; both hands turn and reposition the same object.",
    "00:05.750–00:06.250: Left hand supports the mechanism while right fingertips manipulate its protruding metal crank; the crank remains attached to the mechanism.",
    "00:06.500–00:09.750: Right hand repeatedly rotates the attached crank while left hand continuously holds the mechanism. Finger occlusion and motion blur intermittently obscure the crank, with no visible detachment, substitution, duplication, or unexplained relocation."
